g1.label: 1. Priya studies in English and ___
g1.why: The text says Priya studies at school in English and Hindi.

g2.label: 2. Priya wants to study ___
g2.why: The text says Priya wants to study medicine at university.

g3.label: 3. Jake lives in ___
g3.why: The text says Jake lives in Auckland, the largest city in New Zealand.

g4.label: 4. "Kia ora" is a greeting in ___
g4.why: The text says "Kia ora" is a greeting in Māori.

g5.label: 5. Kenya gained independence in ___
g5.why: The text says Kenya gained its independence from Britain in 1963.

g6.label: 6. Amara's school day begins at ___
g6.why: The text says Amara's school day begins at seven.

g7.label: 7. Amara helps her mother at a ___
g7.why: The text says Amara helps her mother at a market stall after school.

g8.label: 8. Kenya is well-known for ___
g8.why: The text says Kenya is especially well-known for its athletes in long-distance running.

g1.label: 1. Priya ___ (ongoing now)
g1.why: ‘At the moment’ signals an action happening right now, so the present continuous ‘is training’ is used.

g2.label: 2. Bollywood ___ (permanent fact)
g2.why: A permanent fact or general truth uses the simple present ‘produces’.

g3.label: 3. Jake ___ his weekends (regular habit)
g3.why: A regular habit uses the simple present ‘spends’.

g4.label: 4. Jake's friends ___ the haka (ability/fact)
g4.why: ‘Can’ expresses a general ability or fact.

g5.label: 5. Amara's school ___ at seven (schedule)
g5.why: A regular schedule uses the simple present ‘starts’.

g6.label: 6. Kenyan athletes ___ medals
g6.why: An achievement built up over time with present relevance uses the present perfect ‘have won’.

g7.label: 7. "Look — Jake ___" (this moment)
g7.why: ‘Look’ signals something happening right now, so the present continuous ‘is surfing’ is used.

g8.label: 8. Amara ___ her mother since she was twelve
g8.why: ‘Since’ with an action that started in the past and continues now uses the present perfect continuous.

g1.label: 1. Countries once part of the British Empire
g1.why: The Commonwealth is the group of countries, most once part of the British Empire, that work together.

g2.label: 2. Original people before settlers arrived
g2.why: ‘Indigenous people’ describes the original inhabitants of a place before settlers arrived.

g3.label: 3. Freedom to self-govern
g3.why: ‘Independence’ is the freedom of a country to govern itself without outside control.

g4.label: 4. Traditional dance expressing identity
g4.why: The haka is the traditional Māori dance or ceremony expressing group identity mentioned in the text.

g5.label: 5. Way of life, traditions, arts, beliefs
g5.why: ‘Culture’ covers the way of life, traditions, arts and beliefs shared by a group.

g6.label: 6. Very different things in the same place
g6.why: ‘Contrasts’ describes things that are very different from each other within the same situation.

g7.label: 7. Protected land for wild animals
g7.why: A ‘national park’ is a large area of protected land open to visitors where wild animals live.

g8.label: 8. Pride from belonging to a group/nation
g8.why: ‘National identity’ describes the pride and belonging that comes from being part of a nation.
